 Martin Garrix Reveals Release Date For New Album ‘Marty’
 Published
 1 day ago on
 October 20, 2026 
 By
 Mackenzie Morris 
 Martin Garrix reveals the release date for Marty , his third studio album, after previewing new music during an intimate ADE set for top Spotify listeners
 Martin Garrix kicked off his Amsterdam Dance Event week with an intimate DJ set for some of his top Spotify listeners. At the end of the set, he revealed that his new album Marty will be released on March 5, 2027 . The project will be his third studio album and takes its name from Garrix ’s early DJ moniker, DJ Marty .
 New Music Previewed During ADE 
 Martin Garrix ’s last album came in 2022 with SENTIO , the first album he released under the name Martin Garrix . His debut album, Greatest Hits Vol. 1 , came the year before through his AREA21 project. After several years without another full-length project, the release date finally gives listeners a confirmed timeline for Marty .
 Those attending the Spotify set also heard some unreleased material from the upcoming album. Martin Garrix previewed another track featuring his own vocals, following his vocal performance on Dream of You . With Marty now confirmed for March 5 , more music from the album could surface as the release gets closer.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by EDM House Network (@edmhousenetwork) 
 What We Know About Marty So Far
 The album follows a year in which Martin Garrix has started bringing his own vocals further into his music. This Dream Of You , released in October 2026 , followed earlier material that also featured Martin Garrix singing, giving the upcoming project a more personal element alongside the festival records associated with his catalogue.
 A full tracklist for Marty has not yet been revealed, so there is still plenty left to learn before March 5, 2027 . The unreleased material played during the Spotify event adds another clue, especially as Martin Garrix continues experimenting with his own voice across new music.
 With Amsterdam Dance Event only just beginning, Martin Garrix has already given listeners one of the week’s biggest announcements. Marty is still several months away, but its release date and the new material played in Amsterdam offer the first clearer look at what he has planned for the album.
